name: jleape-github-io-private
description: Build + encrypt scripts for the stealth apps served from this site.

scripts.encrypt:gambiarra: staticrypt private/_src/apps/gambiarra/dist/index.html -p "$STATICRYPT_PW" --short --remember 30 -d apps/gambiarra --template-title Stealth --template-instructions "Enter password to continue." --template-button Unlock
scripts.publish:gambiarra: npm run install:gambiarra && npm run build:gambiarra && npm run encrypt:gambiarra
scripts.install:aji: npm install --prefix private/_src/apps/aji && npm install --prefix private/_src/apps/aji-marketplace
scripts.build:aji: cp /Users/jleape/workspace/claude_apps/aji/prototype/aji_fund_thesis_v34.pdf private/_src/apps/aji/src/aji_fund_thesis_v34.pdf && npm run build --prefix private/_src/apps/aji && npm run build --prefix private/_src/apps/aji-marketplace
scripts.bundle:aji: mkdir -p apps/aji && cp private/_src/apps/aji/dist/index.html apps/aji/index.html && cp private/_src/apps/aji-marketplace/dist/index.html apps/aji/marketplace.html
scripts.publish:aji: npm run install:aji && npm run build:aji && npm run bundle:aji
scripts.encrypt:rally: staticrypt private/_src/apps/rally/dist/index.html -p "$STATICRYPT_PW_RALLY" --short --remember 30 -d apps/rally --template-title Stealth --template-instructions "Enter password to continue." --template-button Unlock
scripts.publish:rally: npm run install:rally && npm run extract:rally && npm run build:rally && npm run encrypt:rally
scripts.encrypt:dsm: staticrypt private/_src/apps/dsm/dist/index.html -p "$STATICRYPT_PW_DSM" --short --remember 30 -d apps/dsm --template-title Stealth --template-instructions "Enter password to continue." --template-button Unlock
scripts.publish:dsm: npm run install:dsm && npm run build:dsm && npm run encrypt:dsm
scripts.encrypt:supply: staticrypt private/_src/apps/supply/dist/index.html -p "$STATICRYPT_PW_SUPPLY" --short --remember 30 -d apps/supply --template-title Stealth --template-instructions "Enter password to continue." --template-button Unlock
scripts.publish:supply: npm run build:supply && npm run encrypt:supply
